key_facts: History of complete heart block with permanent pacemaker implantation
Dilated left ventricular cavity with LV wall hypertrophy

shortlist.label: Sarcoid cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Cardiac granulomatous disease on PET scan

shortlist.label: Dilated cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Dilated left ventricular cavity with LV wall hypertrophy and low ejection fraction

shortlist.label: Tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Wide complex tachycardia and low ejection fraction

shortlist.label: Ischemic cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: History of complete heart block and elevated troponin levels

shortlist.label: Giant cell myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac MRI and clinical presentation

raw.rationale: The presence of cardiac granulomatous disease on PET scan, patchy late gadolinium enhancement on cardiac MRI, and the combination of heart failure symptoms and significant left ventricular dysfunction are most consistent with sarcoid cardiomyopathy.

rejected.label: Dilated cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has a dilated left ventricle and reduced ejection fraction, the presence of granulomatous disease suggests a more specific etiology than idiopathic dilated cardiomyopathy.

rejected.label: Tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: The wide complex tachycardia could contribute to cardiomyopathy, but the granulomatous disease and late gadolinium enhancement point towards an underlying inflammatory process.

rejected.label: Ischemic cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: The absence of significant coronary disease on cardiac catheterization makes ischemic cardiomyopathy less likely.

rejected.label: Giant cell myocarditis
rejected.why: While giant cell myocarditis is an inflammatory condition, the presence of granulomatous disease and the pattern of cardiac involvement are more suggestive of sarcoidosis than giant cell myocarditis.
